name: freee
description: freee lets agents read and update accounting, invoice, HR and payroll, and time-tracking data in the signed-in freee account. Each user signs in to their own freee account through the browser.

prompts.text: Summarize this month's income and expenses in freee accounting.
List the invoices that are past their due date.
Draft an invoice for 10 hours of consulting to Example Co.

apps.name: freee
apps.description: Accounting, invoice, HR, and time-tracking access, over freee's MCP server with browser sign-in.
